tasks.label: Preview site
tasks.detail: Regenerate data files and serve docs/ at http://127.0.0.1:8080
tasks.command: python3 scripts/build_changes_index.py && python3 scripts/build_quirks.py && python3 scripts/build_credits.py && python3 scripts/build_gallery.py && python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory docs

tasks.label: Preview site (show unpublished)
tasks.detail: Like Preview site, but reveals releases newer than latest_published (SHOW_UNPUBLISHED=1)
tasks.command: python3 scripts/build_changes_index.py && python3 scripts/build_quirks.py && python3 scripts/build_credits.py && python3 scripts/build_gallery.py && python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory docs
